messages:
marta: Heads-up: Orion Edge (hardware + systems integrator) asked for a private marketplace offer that bundles our Dedicated GPU credits + their on-prem appliance rebate. They want a go-live press mention tied to their Q3 field summit. We need pricing bands, renewal mechanics, and a short "fast-start" service SKU. Who owns what?

tom: I can sketch tiers. prefer 12-month commit with optional ramp months. also propose a 2-yr discounted option for larger customers.

jess: Sales perspective: field wants a short enrollment sweetener to accelerate Q2 closes. propose a time-limited "early-adopter credit" (applied to month 1-3). Also need clear displacement rules for cloud credits.

alan: Ops note: marketplace private-offer must state billing cadence (monthly/quarterly), payout mapping for HW rebate, and where invoice VAT sits. We'll need partner PO + SOW to enable HW rebate pass-through.

legal-bot: Reminder: avoid language that implies guaranteed HW rebate without partner agreement. add export controls clause and data processing terms for on-prem deployments. auto-renew opt-out must be explicit.

partner-ops-bot: Proposed launch windows saved: internal announce 2026-06-10, public marketplace listing + partner press 2026-06-17. Confirm by EOD Tue to hit summit date.

marta: Tom, can you post a concrete pricing sketch here? Include SKU names we can use for private-offer mapping.

tom: Draft commit structure (USD, 12-mo unless noted):
```
Commit tiers:
- Trial Ramp: $5k/mo -> 5% discount, no HW rebate, 30d pilot add-on available
- Growth: $40k/mo -> 13% discount, $15k HW rebate pass-through, 90-day early-adopter credit (10% of first 3 months)
- Strategic (12mo): $150k/mo -> 22% discount + $50k HW rebate pass-through + 2-week fast-start service credit
- Strategic+ (24mo): $150k/mo committed for 24mo -> 26% discount, $50k HW rebate + 12-mo fixed price protection
Notes: quarterly true-up; optional monthly ramp in months 1-3; enrollment credit applied as invoice credit.
```

jess: That looks good. Sales wants the fast-start as an add-on for Growth to preserve margin. For Strategic we can include 2-week onboarding.

alan: Ops: we need SKU suggestions for mapping in marketplace catalog. Suggest: rwd-orion-trial-v1, rwd-orion-growth-v1, rwd-orion-strategic-v1, rwd-orion-strategicplus-v1, rwd-orion-faststart-2w.

marta: Good. Legal, any red flags with the two-year Strategic+ pricing protection?

legal-bot: Two things: (1) any price protection must include a cap on cumulative discounts if partner issues additional credits; (2) require 60-day cancellation for multi-year renewals and limit automatic renewals to one-year renewal terms. I'll draft clause language.

partner-ops-bot: Marketplace listing guidance: show a short private-offer summary (one-line), link to private-offer redemption URL, partner logo tile, and an FAQ entry that points to MSA + SOW contact. Keep marketplace copy neutral on HW rebate specifics.

marta: Action items: Tom -> finalize pricing table + enrollment credit math by EOD; Jess -> field enablement one-pager and playbook (include displacement rules); Alan -> SKU registration + billing flow doc; Legal -> redline clause set. I'll coordinate press blurbs with comms.

jess: Also suggest a "renewal accelerator" for customers that commit to an additional 12 months within the final 90 days: apply a one-time credit equal to 5% of next-term commit to be used for HW or service. Good incentive for renewals.

legal-bot: Ok to include renewal accelerator conditional on partner approval and subject to usage caps. Add clear redemption window.

marta: Lock timeline: need final private-offer file and marketplace SKU mapping by 2026-06-02 to publish on 2026-06-17. Ping if blockers.

tom: Will send updated spreadsheet + private-offer JSON by lunchtime tomorrow.

alan: I'll start SKU registration and flag any tax/VAT nuances with finance.

marta: Thanks team. If Orion PM escalates ping me @marta. :rocket:
